scope: Local Accounts and selected Wiki Orca journeys

journeys.expected: Sign-in controls and local issuer metadata match the running stack.
journeys.result: Accounts redirects to Sign in; Google continuation control visible; local discovery issuer and authorization endpoint match.

journeys.expected: Wiki authorization parameters and signed sign-in continuation remain intact.
journeys.result: Real Wiki sign-in preserves client wiki, callback, code response, S256 PKCE, state and signed unexpired continuation.

journeys.expected: Accounts session alone completes real local OIDC and creates a Wiki session.
journeys.result: Accounts fixture alone completed real authorize/callback/token exchange; RP identity Platform OIDC Admin persisted after reload.

journeys.expected: Accounts session ends, Wiki user is null, and authenticated settings require sign-in.
journeys.result: Accounts session/user null after signout, Wiki settings starts Accounts signin, and actual Wiki user API returns null without clearing cookies.

journeys.expected: Created and edited title/body remain after reload.
journeys.result: Actual create POST202 and edit POST200; original and changed title/body persist through reload and page navigation.

journeys.expected: A real comment POST succeeds, resets its editor, and persists after reload.
journeys.result: Actual comment POST200, empty editor after success, visible persisted comment after reload.

journeys.expected: Keyword results contain an accessible page and omit it for a denied member.
journeys.result: Keyword author result contains created page; member has no result and actual page GET404.

journeys.expected: Admin sees runner status and member gets real HTTP 403.
journeys.result: Admin sees empty runner status. Member receives403 in browser and authenticated HTTP.

journeys.expected: Admin persists and restores a space name while member receives HTTP 403.
journeys.result: Actual UI save persisted after reload. Original GDG Japan name restored through UI. Member receives403.

journeys.expected: Viewer controls remain read-only and duplicate/move requests return 403.
journeys.result: Duplicate, move and trash are disabled. Personal text setting works. Actual duplicate and move requests return403; ACL remains viewer.

journeys.expected: Rendered and copied Markdown omit organizer-only content under language fallback.
journeys.result: English fallback renders public marker and hides organizer marker. Native clipboard after actual copy excludes private marker and ACL tags.

journeys.expected: Share overview, copy link, Escape, and focus restoration work.
journeys.result: Sharing shows correct title and access, copies exact link, closes with Escape, and restores Share focus. Mobile follow-up after the modal fix opens sharing after menu teardown, then one Escape restores the accessible page and More actions focus.

journeys.expected: Small text and full width persist for the selected page without affecting another page.
journeys.result: Small text is14px; full width changes768 to976. Both persist on reload and remain unset for a second page.

journeys.expected: A requested translation, completed by a runner over the real runner API, is shown on the English page.
journeys.result: Translation requested; lease returned translate job; token-less lease 401; translation POST 200 and result 200, duplicate result 409 lease_lost; English view shows E2E Test Page (verify EN), translated text, and Auto-translated.

journeys.expected: Runner heartbeat and finished job appear on the admin page.
journeys.result: translate · succeeded: 1 and the recent job listed; after heartbeat, verify-fake-runner · idle, seen 0 min ago.

exclusions: Deployed Cloudflare services and production role assignments
Knowledge ingestion (synthesis from sources), agent requests on agent-authored pages, and AI search
Every Wiki route, mutation, locale, and viewport
